messages:
Support Ops Bot: New ticket SUP-8421 from Neurolytics — AP is rejecting invoices unless they include a Requisition ID (REQ_ID). They will not accept a standard PO file; they expect a REQ_ID field on the invoice metadata. Holding invoices until we provide REQ_ID.

Jess R.: Thanks — adding to billing queue. Do we have a standard process for customers that require a REQ_ID instead of a PO?

Sara L.: Not usually. Most enterprise customers accept a PO or a requisition attached. This one specifically says their AP system rejects invoices missing the REQ_ID value (their SAP interface).

Tony H.: Quick workaround we used before: issue a pro-forma invoice and include a placeholder requisition id in the invoice metadata, then replace it once procurement provides the real REQ_ID. Need signoff from sales/account owner.

Procurement Mike: I can reach out to the buyer contact. If they insist on the REQ_ID being present, ask them to confirm one of these: vendor code, requisition format (prefix), and whether they allow a temporary placeholder like "PENDING-REQ". Also confirm who in their AP team will accept an amended invoice.

Jess R.: Ticket notes: customer wants the REQ_ID value in invoice JSON under invoice.metadata.requisition_id or their SAP REF field. Support case link: https://support.redwood.ai/SUP-8421

Tony H.: For accounting automation, send this minimal invoice metadata payload so their parser gets the field: ```json
{
  "invoice": {
    "number": "INV-2026-PF",
    "amount": "7500.00",
    "currency": "USD",
    "metadata": {
      "requisition_id": "PENDING-NEURO-8421",
      "vendor_code": "REDWOOD_AI"
    }
  }
}
```

Accounting Bot: Created provisional invoice INV-2026-PF (status: HOLD-REQ). Link: https://app.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-PF. Internal note: DO NOT finalize until REQ_ID confirmed.

Sara L.: @Procurement Mike please copy the buyer and ask for the exact REQ_ID format (digits vs alphanumeric) and whether they accept an amended invoice. If they require a signed document from our legal/sales, escalate to AE.

Procurement Mike: Will do. I'll DM the buyer and update SUP-8421 with timestamps and any sample req IDs they provide.

Jess R.: :thumbsup: I'll keep billing on hold and update the customer communication template to say we can issue a pro-forma with a placeholder requisition_id and amend once they confirm. Saves a full procurement onboarding loop.

Tony H.: If they don't allow placeholders, next step is to request the 'requisition reference' from sales before we invoice. Note for records: preferred invoice field names we support: requisition_id, order_reference, ref1.

Accounting Bot: Invoice INV-2026-PF set to HOLD-REQ at 2025-07-02T15:45:30Z (internal).

Jess R.: I'll ping again in 48 hours if no reply from buyer.
